panels.description: The passage opens into old lithium workings. A broad maintained industrial uplink crosses above a narrow pipe labeled KEEL RESIDENTIAL. Leave upper chamber space.
The residential pipe is nearly dry, stained orange and white. Leave upper pipe space.
A newer white-and-amber control node glows beside an analog gauge. Adrian's equation is scratched into the housing. Leave upper machinery space.
Alex presses his palm to the broad uplink while Ada watches. Leave upper pipe space.
